label: Latest retained study · 31 October 2026
strategyTitle: The shallow tree does not show stable improvement over reversal
factorTitle: Tree and momentum rankings remain inconsistent
conclusion: The new shallow-tree and 20-session momentum tests do not establish a stable advantage over simple reversal. No strategy has been promoted.
counts: 168 parent simulated-account configurations reused; 96 new simulated-account configurations requested. There were 12 new fit starts. Of the new configurations, 60 completed and 36 were blocked: 18 with unusable ranking pools and 18 crossing known corporate-action boundaries.
scope: Both historical windows were already exposed. The 432 prespecified matched comparisons share history and overlapping labels; they are not independent trials. Uncertainty estimates remain unavailable. Execution prices, liquidity, capacity and live tradability remain unverified.
method: Each row matches window, horizon, one-way modeled fee, delay and retention buffer. Equal weight always uses buffer 0; other references use the selected buffer. Returns use a raw-price USD cash ledger, not total returns. Every window starts a separate account.
factorMethod: RankIC is the daily rank correlation between model scores and later raw-price returns, averaged over valid dates. The table shows the eight new model/window/horizon summaries. Positive IC means the rankings moved in the same direction; it does not establish an investable return.
nojs: All rows are available below. JavaScript enables the selectors; unavailable comparisons retain their reasons and are never treated as zero.

provenanceBody: The separate public snapshot is a closed projection of independently rechecked saved outputs and their bound parent. Published hashes bind the protocol, inputs, parent record, source, locks, report and verification. No model was fitted to publish this page.
rules: Top 50; buffers 0/20; horizons 5/20; fees 0/20/40 bps; delays 0/1. Trees use fixed depths 2/3, at most six starts per horizon and a 60-session inner validation window. These are retrospective estimates, with no live-trading authorization.
